commands.teamprojecte.help:
ProjectE Team - team management Available commands: invite Invite players to your team leave Leave your team members List team members kick Kick players from your team transfer_ownership

Transfer team ownership accept Accept an invitation decline Decline an invitation settings [v] Change team settings rename Rename the team info Show team details create Create your team delete Delete your team (owner only) join Join a free team by name (UUID also works) Settings: settings share_emc [v] true/false Share EMC with the team (bare = toggle for owner) settings share_knowledge [v] true/false Share knowledge with the team (bare = toggle for owner) settings name Rename the team settings free_join [v] true/false Accept free joins (bare = toggle) vanish [on|off] Hide yourself from team listings (bare = toggle) Requirements: - invite, leave, members, accept, decline: must be in a team - kick, transfer_ownership, settings, rename, delete: must be the team owner - info: must be in a team
